mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and increasing the present value of future cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.8% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, which increases the likelihood of central bank rate cuts, thereby boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average 20-day return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction permits (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in private demand, which triggers a policy response from the Federal Reserve, leading to lower long-term interest rates and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 1300 and RSAFS < 460000 in the same month
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the joint Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 103.0 for two consecutive months signals a contraction in real output, which increases the probability of a recession and triggers risk-off behavior in equity markets, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in fewer than 60% of triggered instances, or the average 5-day return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the year-over-year CPI inflation rate above 3.5% triggers a hawkish monetary policy stance, leading to higher discount rates and reduced equity valuations, which results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A synchronized increase in both real personal consumption (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong underlying demand momentum, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 465000 and INDPRO > 104.0 in the same month
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to generate positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 250k in a single month signals strong labor market demand, which increases inflationary pressures and raises the likelihood of Fed rate hikes, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in fewer than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized in the most recent quarter signals a weakening economy, which increases the probability of fiscal or monetary stimulus, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
